# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_2/brief/sio2_quenching_2_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_4/structure.data

pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# Compute temperature
compute mytemp all temp

# NPT ensemble setup
fix npt_quench all npt temp 5000 1500 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Run quenching simulation
